messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: RStudio Server
parts:
Hi, Kenji. It doesn't appear that anyone has responded to your
query. If you still need help, let me suggest that you might want to
elaborate on your requirements. If this is (mostly) for your personal
use, you can:

(1) always run a shiny app on your own machine:

https://www.rstudio.com/products/shiny/download-server/

(2) download the open-source edition of Rstudio server:

https://www.rstudio.com/products/rstudio/download-server/

I don't know what campus-wide (or department-wide) resources might be
available to you.

-- Mike
